coordinates.object_orientation: Body axis Y, head toward -Y, tail +Y, dorsal +Z. Front -Y, side+X, top+Z, perspective(+X,-Y,+Z).

concept.reason: True same-specimen normal/UV photos with scale and published diagnosis suffice; no extra concepts.

scope: Whole Jurassic animal, not isolated carapace. Shape anchor lectotype MNHN.F.A32407, early Tithonian Solnhofen. Conservative living restoration, not a scan.

scale.note: CLmax and UL from Audo et al Table1 same specimen. 95mm body and57mm width approximate Fig1B 2cm scale, uncertainty roughly5mm; thickness cannot be measured in compressed fossil. Overall span includes articulated legs and is not body length.

anatomy: Broad flattened nearly circular carapace, each side with two deep incisions separating three lateral margin regions; weak dorsal ridges, no giant lobster cylinder.
Five pairs walking appendages. P1 strongest and longest; P2-P4 progressively smaller but also chelate; P5 smallest and NOT chelate. No five equal pairs or only two claws.
Six exposed abdominal segments followed by telson and paired two-part uropods. Uropodal exopods petaloid, no diaeresis; outer lobe9.7mm same-specimen measurement. Tail stays exposed beyond shell.
Small anterior eyestalks and two paired antenna/antennule systems restored conservatively, short filamentous rather than long modern spiny-lobster whips.
Original planning phrase short front pincers is not a hard anatomical instruction: real P1 is larger and longer than all posterior legs. Slender claw fingers, not massive modern lobster fists.
restoration_boundaries: Carapace outline, lateral incisions, serial appendages, abdomen and tail fan anchored Fig1A/B same specimen.

Missing/overlapping appendage portions may be bilaterally completed using visible counterparts and published same-genus diagnosis. Exact stance, ventral thickness, eyes/antenna tip dimensions and color inferred.
Museum describes incomplet while2012 figure caption says complete specimen: means whole-body preservation, not every terminal structure intact. No claim of perfectly complete fossil.
Do not substitute Knebelia or Cycleryon anatomy from adjacent table/figures.2014 used only A32407 measurement row.
quality_gates: QA confirms all5 bilateral leg pairs; P1-P4 chelate/P5nonchelate; distinguish carapace length from wholebody.
Top view exposes two notches per side and segmented abdomen/tail fan; side shows shallow carapace, not pancake paper or swollen lobster.
Four final views only; cheap grey anatomy checks first; no new external tests imposed.
